title_en: OJK's PASTI Task Force shuts 16 illegal investment entities, with schemes ranging from computing rental and "USDT" to paid movie-watching
summary_en: The Task Force for the Eradication of Illegal Financial Activities (Satgas PASTI) has halted the activities of 16 entities suspected of fraud through investment offers. The schemes include paid tasks with deposits, crypto and forex investment, AI ads featuring public figures, and impersonation of licensed companies.
key_points_en: Satgas PASTI halted the activities of 16 entities suspected of offering illegal investments, according to a written statement cited by CNBC Indonesia and detikFinance on Tuesday (10/11/2026).

Ten entities, including GPUCore, PilotXone, EarnTycoon, ZEDT, USDT AL and Task 33, are suspected of fraud through computing-rental offers with task schemes, deposits and member-get-member recruitment.
OneTwoMarkets is suspected of offering investment in forex, commodities, crypto, stocks and indices, and of using AI technology featuring public figures to convince potential victims.

Other schemes involved impersonating licensed companies, such as Easycash (PT Indonesia Fintopia Technology) and Guotai Haitong Securities, as well as MAERA with tasks of watching films and buying film copyrights.
Access to the related apps and links has been blocked. Reports can be made via sipasti.ojk.go.id or OJK Contact 157.
why_en: Many scams use terms familiar to crypto users, such as "USDT", GPU computing or crypto trading, to look convincing. Checking legality before depositing funds is the most basic protection.
body_en: Indonesia's Financial Services Authority (OJK), through the Task Force for the Eradication of Illegal Financial Activities (Satgas PASTI), has halted the activities of 16 entities suspected of offering illegal investments to the public. Satgas PASTI said this in a written statement on Tuesday (10/11/2026), as cited by CNBC Indonesia and detikFinance.

Most of the entities used task-based schemes. Ten entities named GPUCore, PilotXone, Aset Saham, Orion Wealth, Jadiduit, Impersonasi Easy Cash, EarnTycoon, ZEDT, USDT AL and Task 33 are suspected of investment fraud through computing-rental offers with task schemes, deposits and member-get-member recruitment. According to detikFinance, the ten entities have no legal entity in Indonesia, are not licensed by OJK, and their apps or websites are not registered as Electronic System Operators (PSE).

Satgas PASTI also found schemes involving financial instruments and assets. OneTwoMarkets is suspected of offering investment in forex, commodities, crypto, stocks and indices, and claimed affiliation with a licensed company in South Africa. In its offers, the entity allegedly used artificial intelligence (AI) technology featuring public figures. Verification showed OneTwoMarkets has no legal entity in Indonesia and is not licensed by OJK.

Other schemes included Zahra Berkah, which according to detikFinance promised returns of up to 80% in 30 days; Singapore Bhinneka Capital (SBC), which promised returns of up to three times based on the number of members recruited; Brevondale, which displayed the OJK and KSEI logos; and MAERA, which offered tasks of watching films and buying film copyrights, royalties and productions for daily income.

Satgas PASTI also found impersonation of licensed companies. Orion Wealth used the name of Orion Wealth Management, Impersonasi Easy Cash used the name of PT Indonesia Fintopia Technology (Easycash), and Impersonasi Guotai Haitong used the name of a securities firm licensed in China.

Satgas PASTI has halted these entities' activities, blocked access to the related apps and links (URLs), and will coordinate with law enforcement. People who have suffered losses are asked to report to local law enforcement. Signs of illegal offers can be reported via sipasti.ojk.go.id, OJK Contact 157, WhatsApp 081157157157, or OJK's official email.
tips_title_en: How to check before depositing funds
tips_en: Be wary of promises of high, guaranteed returns, especially ones paid per task or per new member recruited.
Check licensing directly on OJK's official website or via OJK Contact 157, not from logos or certificates shown by the person making the offer.
For crypto assets, use only crypto asset traders licensed and supervised by OJK.

title: IHSG melesat 1,66% di sesi I, rupiah jadi mata uang terkuat Asia pagi ini jelang data inflasi AS
summary: IHSG ditutup naik 1,66% ke 5.158 pada sesi I Selasa (10/11), didorong saham perbankan besar. Rupiah juga menguat ke sekitar Rp18.050 per dolar AS. Pasar kini menunggu rilis inflasi (CPI) AS Oktober malam ini.
key_points: IHSG menguat 1,66% ke posisi 5.158 pada sesi I Selasa (10/11/2026), dengan nilai transaksi Rp3,61 triliun, menurut Bloomberg Technoz.
Di awal perdagangan, saham pengungkit antara lain BBCA, TLKM, ASII, BMRI, dan GOTO, menurut data Refinitiv yang dikutip CNBC Indonesia.
Rupiah menguat 0,11% ke Rp18.050 per dolar AS pada pukul 09.20 WIB, penguatan terbesar di antara 10 mata uang Asia yang dipantau CNBC Indonesia.
Indeks Keyakinan Konsumen (IKK) Bank Indonesia naik ke 119,9 pada Oktober 2026 dari 118,1, tertinggi sejak Mei.
CPI AS Oktober dirilis Selasa pukul 20.30 WIB, atau 21.30 WITA (13.30 UTC).
why_it_matters: Pasar saham, rupiah, dan crypto sama-sama sensitif terhadap arah suku bunga AS. Hasil CPI malam ini bisa mengubah sentimen di semua pasar tersebut, termasuk harga aset kripto dalam rupiah.
body: Pasar keuangan Indonesia bergerak positif pada Selasa (10/11/2026). Menurut Bloomberg Technoz, Indeks Harga Saham Gabungan (IHSG) ditutup menguat 1,66% ke posisi 5.158 pada sesi I, setelah sempat menyentuh 5.160. Volume transaksi mencapai 8,78 miliar saham dengan nilai Rp3,61 triliun. Sebanyak 445 saham naik, 137 turun, dan 126 tidak bergerak.

Bloomberg Technoz menyebut saham PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BBRI) sebagai salah satu pendorong, naik 1,42% ke Rp2.860 per saham. Di awal perdagangan, CNBC Indonesia mengutip data Refinitiv bahwa saham pengungkit IHSG antara lain BBCA, TLKM, ASII, BMRI, dan GOTO, dengan sektor material dasar naik 2%.

Rupiah juga menguat. CNBC Indonesia, mengutip data Refinitiv, mencatat rupiah naik 0,11% ke Rp18.050 per dolar AS pada pukul 09.20 WIB, penguatan paling tajam di antara 10 mata uang Asia yang dipantau. Won Korea Selatan menjadi yang paling melemah, turun 0,38%. ANTARA melaporkan rupiah dibuka menguat 16 poin atau 0,09% ke Rp18.069 per dolar AS.
Dari dalam negeri, Bank Indonesia merilis Indeks Keyakinan Konsumen (IKK) Oktober 2026 yang naik ke 119,9 dari 118,1 pada September, tertinggi sejak Mei, menurut CNBC Indonesia dan Republika.

Perhatian pasar kini beralih ke data inflasi konsumen (CPI) AS bulan Oktober yang dirilis Selasa pukul 08.30 waktu New York, atau 20.30 WIB / 21.30 WITA (13.30 UTC). CNBC Indonesia mencatat, berdasarkan CME FedWatch, pelaku pasar memperkirakan peluang sekitar 85% The Fed menaikkan suku bunga pada Desember.
analysis: Penguatan pagi ini terjadi sebelum data inflasi AS keluar, jadi bisa saja berubah setelah rilis malam nanti. Menurut ekonom CORE Indonesia yang dikutip Tribun Medan, respons pasar domestik yang lebih kuat kemungkinan baru terlihat Rabu (11/11). Ini interpretasi, bukan prediksi harga.

title_en: IDX Composite jumps 1.66% in session I, rupiah is Asia's strongest currency this morning ahead of US inflation data
summary_en: The IDX Composite (IHSG) closed session I on Tuesday (10/11) up 1.66% at 5,158, driven by large bank stocks. The rupiah also strengthened to about Rp18,050 per US dollar. Markets are now waiting for tonight's US October inflation (CPI) release.
key_points_en: The IDX Composite rose 1.66% to 5,158 in session I on Tuesday (10/11/2026), with trading value of Rp3.61 trillion, according to Bloomberg Technoz.
Early in trading, the index movers included BBCA, TLKM, ASII, BMRI and GOTO, according to Refinitiv data cited by CNBC Indonesia.
The rupiah rose 0.11% to Rp18,050 per US dollar at 09.20 WIB, the biggest gain among the 10 Asian currencies tracked by CNBC Indonesia.
Bank Indonesia's Consumer Confidence Index (IKK) rose to 119.9 in October 2026 from 118.1, the highest since May.
US October CPI is released on Tuesday at 20.30 WIB, or 21.30 WITA (13.30 UTC).
why_en: Stocks, the rupiah and crypto are all sensitive to the direction of US interest rates. Tonight's CPI result could shift sentiment across all of these markets, including crypto asset prices in rupiah.
body_en: Indonesian financial markets moved higher on Tuesday (10/11/2026). According to Bloomberg Technoz, the IDX Composite (IHSG) closed session I up 1.66% at 5,158, after touching 5,160. Trading volume reached 8.78 billion shares worth Rp3.61 trillion. A total of 445 stocks rose, 137 fell and 126 were unchanged.

Bloomberg Technoz named shares of PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BBRI) as one of the drivers, up 1.42% at Rp2,860 per share. Early in trading, CNBC Indonesia cited Refinitiv data showing the index movers included BBCA, TLKM, ASII, BMRI and GOTO, with the basic materials sector up 2%.

The rupiah also strengthened. CNBC Indonesia, citing Refinitiv data, reported the rupiah rose 0.11% to Rp18,050 per US dollar at 09.20 WIB, the sharpest gain among the 10 Asian currencies tracked. The South Korean won was the weakest, down 0.38%. ANTARA reported the rupiah opened 16 points or 0.09% stronger at Rp18,069 per US dollar.
Domestically, Bank Indonesia released its October 2026 Consumer Confidence Index (IKK), which rose to 119.9 from 118.1 in September, the highest since May, according to CNBC Indonesia and Republika.

Market attention now turns to US consumer inflation (CPI) data for October, released on Tuesday at 8:30 a.m. New York time, or 20.30 WIB / 21.30 WITA (13.30 UTC). CNBC Indonesia noted that, based on CME FedWatch, market participants see about an 85% chance the Fed raises interest rates in December.
analysis_en: This morning's gains came before the US inflation data, so they could change after tonight's release. According to a CORE Indonesia economist cited by Tribun Medan, a stronger domestic market response may only show on Wednesday (11/11). This is interpretation, not a price prediction.

title: Bank dan broker besar AS makin masuk crypto: Schwab buka trading SOL, AVAX, LINK; PNC uji terima pembayaran USDC
summary: Charles Schwab menambah Solana, Avalanche, dan Chainlink ke platform Schwab Crypto, sehingga total ada lima aset. Di hari yang sama, PNC Bank meluncurkan pilot bagi klien korporat untuk menerima pembayaran stablecoin USDC lewat Coinbase.
key_points: Charles Schwab mengumumkan pada 9 November 2026 bahwa klien Schwab Crypto kini bisa membeli dan menjual SOL, AVAX, dan LINK, selain bitcoin dan ethereum.
Schwab Crypto mulai diluncurkan bertahap pada Mei 2026 dan tersedia untuk semua klien ritel yang memenuhi syarat sejak Oktober. Biayanya 0,75% dari nilai tiap transaksi.
Menurut Finance Magnates dan crypto.news, layanan ini tidak tersedia untuk penduduk New York dan Louisiana, wilayah teritori AS, maupun luar negeri.
PNC Bank, juga pada 9 November, meluncurkan pilot terbatas agar klien Corporate & Institutional Banking bisa menerima USDC di jaringan Ethereum lewat produk Coinbase Payment.
USDC yang diterima otomatis dikonversi 1:1 ke dolar AS dan disetor ke rekening PNC klien.
why_it_matters: Langkah ini menunjukkan lembaga keuangan tradisional di AS terus memperluas akses ke aset kripto dan stablecoin. Ini juga menambah jalur akses institusi dan ritel ke altcoin besar, bukan hanya BTC dan ETH.
body: Charles Schwab mengumumkan pada Senin (9/11/2026) bahwa tiga token baru kini bisa dibeli dan dijual di platform Schwab Crypto: Solana (SOL), Avalanche (AVAX), dan Chainlink (LINK). Dengan tambahan ini, klien Schwab Crypto bisa memperdagangkan lima aset digital: bitcoin, ethereum, solana, avalanche, dan chainlink.

Menurut rilis resmi Schwab, Schwab Crypto mulai diluncurkan ke klien pada Mei 2026 dan tersedia untuk semua klien ritel yang memenuhi syarat sejak Oktober. Schwab menyebut biaya transaksinya 75 basis poin, atau 0,75% dari nilai tiap transaksi, dan berencana menambah aset digital lain secara bertahap.

Finance Magnates dan crypto.news melaporkan layanan ini disediakan lewat Charles Schwab Premier Bank, SSB, dan tidak tersedia bagi penduduk New York dan Louisiana, wilayah teritori AS, maupun yurisdiksi internasional. Finance Magnates juga mencatat aset kripto di layanan ini tidak dilindungi asuransi FDIC maupun SIPC.

Pada hari yang sama, PNC Bank mengumumkan klien Corporate & Institutional Banking kini bisa menerima pembayaran USDC, stablecoin yang didukung dolar AS, di jaringan Ethereum lewat produk Coinbase Payment. USDC yang masuk otomatis dikonversi 1:1 ke dolar AS dan disetor ke rekening PNC yang ditunjuk. PNC menyebut layanan ini awalnya ditawarkan terbatas kepada klien yang memenuhi syarat sebagai program pilot.

"Saat ini, ini soal menguji dan belajar bersama klien kami," kata Tom Lang, kepala produk dan operasi treasury management PNC, kepada Reuters. Menurut Cointelegraph, PNC tidak mengungkap biaya, waktu penyelesaian, maupun jumlah klien yang ikut pilot.

title_en: Big US banks and brokers push further into crypto: Schwab opens SOL, AVAX, LINK trading; PNC pilots receiving USDC payments
summary_en: Charles Schwab added Solana, Avalanche and Chainlink to its Schwab Crypto platform, bringing the total to five assets. On the same day, PNC Bank launched a pilot letting corporate clients receive USDC stablecoin payments via Coinbase.
key_points_en: Charles Schwab announced on 9 November 2026 that Schwab Crypto clients can now buy and sell SOL, AVAX and LINK, in addition to bitcoin and ethereum.
Schwab Crypto began rolling out in May 2026 and has been available to all eligible retail clients since October. The fee is 0.75% of the value of each trade.
According to Finance Magnates and crypto.news, the service is not available to residents of New York and Louisiana, US territories, or abroad.
PNC Bank, also on 9 November, launched a limited pilot letting Corporate & Institutional Banking clients receive USDC on the Ethereum network via Coinbase Payment products.
Incoming USDC is automatically converted 1:1 into US dollars and deposited into the client's PNC account.
why_en: These moves show traditional US financial institutions continuing to widen access to crypto assets and stablecoins. They also add access routes for institutions and retail to large altcoins, not just BTC and ETH.
body_en: Charles Schwab announced on Monday (9/11/2026) that three new tokens are now available to buy and sell on the Schwab Crypto platform: Solana (SOL), Avalanche (AVAX) and Chainlink (LINK). With these additions, Schwab Crypto clients can trade five digital assets: bitcoin, ethereum, solana, avalanche and chainlink.

According to Schwab's official release, Schwab Crypto began rolling out to clients in May 2026 and has been available to all eligible retail clients since October. Schwab said its trading fee is 75 basis points, or 0.75% of the value of each trade, and that it plans to add other digital assets over time.

Finance Magnates and crypto.news reported that the service is provided through Charles Schwab Premier Bank, SSB, and is not available to residents of New York and Louisiana, US territories or international jurisdictions. Finance Magnates also noted that crypto holdings in the service are not covered by FDIC insurance or SIPC protection.

On the same day, PNC Bank announced that Corporate & Institutional Banking clients can now receive payments in USDC, a US dollar-backed stablecoin, on the Ethereum network via Coinbase Payment products. Incoming USDC is automatically converted 1:1 into US dollars and deposited into a designated PNC account. PNC said the service is initially offered on a limited basis to eligible clients as a pilot program.

"Right now, this is about testing and learning with our clients," Tom Lang, PNC's head of treasury management product and operations, told Reuters. According to Cointelegraph, PNC did not disclose fees, settlement times or the number of clients in the pilot.

title: Gubernur The Fed Waller dukung kenaikan suku bunga Desember, buka peluang 50 bps jika inflasi inti panas
summary: Gubernur Federal Reserve Christopher Waller mengatakan di London bahwa ia akan mendukung kenaikan suku bunga 25 basis poin pada rapat FOMC Desember, bahkan jika inflasi Oktober membaik. Jika inflasi inti CPI sekitar 0,3% atau lebih, ia menilai kenaikan 50 basis poin perlu dipertimbangkan.
key_points: Waller berbicara di Bank of England Watchers Conference di London, Selasa (10/11/2026), beberapa jam sebelum rilis data inflasi konsumen (CPI) AS Oktober, menurut naskah pidato resmi The Fed.
Ia menyatakan tetap akan mendukung kenaikan suku bunga 25 basis poin pada rapat FOMC Desember meskipun inflasi Oktober membaik dibanding September.

Jika inflasi inti CPI Oktober sekitar 0,3% atau lebih tinggi, Waller menilai kenaikan 50 basis poin perlu dipertimbangkan. Menurutnya, naik hanya 25 basis poin dalam kondisi itu akan mempertaruhkan kredibilitas The Fed.
Menurut Reuters, per penutupan Senin pasar berjangka memperhitungkan peluang sekitar 85% kenaikan suku bunga pada rapat 8-9 Desember ke kisaran 4,00%-4,25%.
CPI AS Oktober dirilis Selasa pukul 08.30 waktu New York, atau 21.30 WITA (13.30 UTC). Ekonom yang disurvei Reuters memperkirakan inflasi inti naik 0,2% secara bulanan.
why_it_matters: Suku bunga AS yang lebih tinggi biasanya membuat dolar lebih kuat dan menekan aset berisiko, termasuk saham dan crypto. Pernyataan Waller membuat data CPI malam ini makin menentukan arah pasar, termasuk Bitcoin dan rupiah.
body: Gubernur Federal Reserve Christopher J. Waller menyampaikan pandangannya tentang ekonomi dan kebijakan moneter AS di Bank of England Watchers Conference, yang digelar King's Business School dan Money, Macro and Finance Society di London, Selasa (10/11/2026). Naskah pidatonya dipublikasikan di situs resmi The Fed.

Menurut Waller, ekonomi AS tumbuh kuat dan pasar tenaga kerja stabil, tetapi inflasi masih terlalu tinggi, jauh di atas target 2%. Ia menilai pengetatan kebijakan moneter lebih lanjut diperlukan "sooner rather than later" (lebih cepat, bukan nanti).

Soal data CPI Oktober yang keluar beberapa jam setelah pidatonya, Waller mengatakan: "While I am hoping for an improvement over September, even if this occurs, I would still support a 25 basis point increase in the FOMC's policy rate at our December meeting." Artinya, meski ia berharap ada perbaikan dibanding September, ia tetap akan mendukung kenaikan 25 basis poin pada rapat Desember.

Ia menambahkan, jika inflasi inti CPI Oktober serupa dua bacaan bulanan sebelumnya, sekitar 0,3% atau lebih, langkah yang lebih kuat mungkin diperlukan. "In that case, I believe a 50 basis point hike in the policy rate should be considered at the December meeting. Hiking only 25 basis points would put our credibility at risk, a risk I am not eager to take," kata Waller. Terjemahan bebasnya: dalam kondisi itu, kenaikan 50 basis poin perlu dipertimbangkan, dan menaikkan hanya 25 basis poin akan mempertaruhkan kredibilitas, risiko yang tidak ingin ia ambil.

Waller juga menjelaskan bahwa ia mendukung keputusan FOMC menahan suku bunga pada rapat Oktober karena komunikasi The Fed sudah membuat pasar memperhitungkan kenaikan. Menurutnya, waktu persis kenaikan tidak terlalu penting, tetapi kenaikan yang sudah diisyaratkan harus benar-benar dilakukan dalam waktu yang wajar. CNBC mencatat keputusan Oktober itu tidak bulat: Gubernur Lisa Cook dan Presiden Fed Cleveland Beth Hammack menyatakan beda pendapat (dissent).

Reuters melaporkan, per penutupan Senin, pasar berjangka suku bunga memperhitungkan peluang sekitar 85% kenaikan pada rapat 8-9 Desember ke kisaran target baru 4,00%-4,25%. CNBC, mengutip CME FedWatch, menyebut pasar memperhitungkan peluang lebih dari 80% kenaikan seperempat poin, tetapi belum memperhitungkan kenaikan setengah poin. Ekonom yang disurvei Reuters memperkirakan inflasi inti CPI Oktober naik 0,2% secara bulanan.
analysis: Pidato ini menaikkan taruhan untuk rilis CPI malam ini. Jika inflasi inti keluar 0,3% atau lebih, pasar bisa mulai memperhitungkan kenaikan yang lebih besar, yang biasanya kurang bersahabat bagi aset berisiko seperti crypto. Jika inflasi lebih rendah dari perkiraan, tekanan itu bisa sedikit mereda. Ini interpretasi, bukan prediksi harga.

title_en: Fed Governor Waller backs a December rate hike, opens the door to 50 bps if core inflation runs hot
summary_en: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said in London that he would support a 25 basis point rate hike at the December FOMC meeting, even if October inflation improves. If core CPI inflation is around 0.3% or higher, he said a 50 basis point hike should be considered.
key_points_en: Waller spoke at the Bank of England Watchers Conference in London on Tuesday (10/11/2026), a few hours before the release of US October consumer price index (CPI) data, according to the Fed's official speech text.
He said he would still support a 25 basis point rate hike at the December FOMC meeting even if October inflation improves compared with September.

If October core CPI inflation is around 0.3% or higher, Waller said a 50 basis point hike should be considered. In his view, hiking only 25 basis points in that case would put the Fed's credibility at risk.
According to Reuters, as of Monday's close futures markets priced in about an 85% chance of a rate hike at the 8-9 December meeting to a range of 4.00%-4.25%.
US October CPI is released on Tuesday at 08:30 New York time, or 21:30 WITA (13:30 UTC). Economists polled by Reuters expect core inflation to rise 0.2% month on month.
why_en: Higher US interest rates usually strengthen the dollar and weigh on risk assets, including stocks and crypto. Waller's remarks make tonight's CPI data even more decisive for market direction, including Bitcoin and the rupiah.
body_en: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher J. Waller set out his views on the US economy and monetary policy at the Bank of England Watchers Conference, held by King's Business School and the Money, Macro and Finance Society in London, on Tuesday (10/11/2026). The text of his speech was published on the Fed's official website.

According to Waller, the US economy is growing strongly and the labor market is stable, but inflation is still too high, well above the 2% target. He said further tightening of monetary policy will be needed "sooner rather than later".

On the October CPI data due a few hours after his speech, Waller said: "While I am hoping for an improvement over September, even if this occurs, I would still support a 25 basis point increase in the FOMC's policy rate at our December meeting." In other words, although he hopes for an improvement over September, he would still support a 25 basis point hike at the December meeting.

He added that if October core CPI inflation is similar to the previous two monthly readings, around 0.3% or higher, a stronger move may be needed. "In that case, I believe a 50 basis point hike in the policy rate should be considered at the December meeting. Hiking only 25 basis points would put our credibility at risk, a risk I am not eager to take," Waller said.

Waller also explained that he supported the FOMC's decision to hold rates at the October meeting because the Fed's communication had already led markets to price in hikes. In his view, the precise timing of the hikes matters less, but the hikes that have been signaled must actually be carried out within a reasonable period. CNBC noted that the October decision was not unanimous: Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack dissented.

Reuters reported that, as of Monday's close, rate futures priced in about an 85% chance of a hike at the 8-9 December meeting to a new target range of 4.00%-4.25%. CNBC, citing CME FedWatch, said markets priced in a better than 80% chance of a quarter-point hike but no chance of a half-point move. Economists polled by Reuters expect October core CPI to rise 0.2% month on month.
analysis_en: This speech raises the stakes for tonight's CPI release. If core inflation comes in at 0.3% or higher, markets may start pricing in a bigger hike, which is usually less friendly to risk assets such as crypto. If inflation is lower than expected, that pressure could ease somewhat. This is interpretation, not a price prediction.

title: Trump Media cetak laba bersih US$409,7 juta di kuartal III berkat bitcoin, pegang sekitar 15.649 BTC
summary: Trump Media & Technology Group (DJT), operator Truth Social, melaporkan laba bersih kuartal III 2026 sebesar US$409,7 juta, sebagian besar dari keuntungan non-tunai aset digital. Pendapatan tercatat US$3,0 juta. Per 30 September, perusahaan memegang sekitar 15.649 BTC, dan sekitar 11.385 BTC di antaranya dijaminkan ke program pengelolaan imbal hasil bitcoin.
key_points: Laba bersih kuartal III 2026 mencapai US$409,7 juta, dibanding rugi US$54,8 juta setahun sebelumnya, menurut siaran pers resmi TMTG.

Sebagian besar laba berasal dari pos non-tunai, yaitu keuntungan bersih terealisasi dan belum terealisasi atas aset digital, aset digital yang dijaminkan, dan efek ekuitas sebesar US$496,1 juta. EBITDA yang disesuaikan masih rugi US$12,3 juta.
Pendapatan naik 205% menjadi US$3,0 juta dari US$1,0 juta, terutama dari langganan Truth API dan Truth+.

Per 30 September, TMTG memegang sekitar 15.649 BTC, dengan sekitar 11.385 BTC dijaminkan ke program pengelolaan imbal hasil bitcoin, serta 7 juta saham ETF IBIT, kata CFO Phillip Juhan dalam panggilan pendapatan.
Perusahaan menjadwalkan rapat pemegang saham khusus pada 14 Desember 2026 untuk memberikan suara atas rencana merger dengan TAE Technologies.
why_it_matters: TMTG termasuk perusahaan publik pemegang bitcoin yang cukup besar. Laporan ini menunjukkan betapa kuatnya harga BTC menggerakkan laba perusahaan semacam ini, ke atas maupun ke bawah, karena sebagian besar laba datang dari penilaian ulang aset, bukan dari bisnis inti.
body: Trump Media & Technology Group Corp. (Nasdaq, NYSE Texas: DJT), operator platform media sosial Truth Social, layanan streaming Truth+, dan merek keuangan Truth.Fi, merilis laporan keuangan kuartal III 2026 pada Senin (9/11) pukul 16.05 waktu New York, atau Selasa (10/11) pukul 05.05 WITA.

Menurut siaran pers resmi, perusahaan membukukan laba bersih US$409,7 juta. Sebagian besar berasal dari pos non-tunai: keuntungan bersih terealisasi dan belum terealisasi atas aset digital, aset digital yang dijaminkan, dan efek ekuitas sebesar US$496,1 juta. Angka itu sebagian diimbangi rugi derivatif US$54,0 juta, beban bunga akresi US$11,9 juta, kompensasi berbasis saham US$9,4 juta, dan beban investasi US$4,0 juta. Hasilnya, EBITDA yang disesuaikan masih rugi US$12,3 juta.

Pendapatan kuartal III naik 205% menjadi US$3,0 juta dari US$1,0 juta setahun sebelumnya. Kenaikan terutama datang dari langganan Truth API, produk lisensi data yang diluncurkan 1 Agustus 2026, dan Truth+. Biaya hukum turun menjadi US$2,4 juta dari US$20,3 juta pada kuartal III 2025. Total aset perusahaan tercatat US$2,5 miliar.

Dalam panggilan pendapatan (earnings call), menurut transkrip yang dipublikasikan The Motley Fool, CFO Phillip Juhan mengatakan bahwa per 30 September perusahaan memegang sekitar 15.649 bitcoin, sekitar 11.385 di antaranya dijaminkan ke program pengelolaan imbal hasil bitcoin, ditambah 7 juta saham iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT). Ia juga menyebut perusahaan membeli 4.359 BTC selama kuartal III dengan dana dari penjualan sebagian kepemilikan IBIT. Ringkasan transkrip itu mencatat keuntungan mark-to-market US$378,1 juta seiring harga bitcoin sekitar US$84.000 pada 30 September.

Menurut crypto.news, kepemilikan bitcoin itu bernilai sekitar US$1,31 miliar pada 30 September. Dengan harga bitcoin US$74.450 pada 10 November, nilainya menjadi sekitar US$1,17 miliar, belum termasuk investasi terpisah di IBIT.

TMTG juga menyatakan pernyataan pendaftaran Form S-4 untuk rencana merger dengan TAE Technologies sudah dinyatakan efektif oleh SEC pada 5 November 2026. Rapat pemegang saham khusus untuk memberikan suara atas merger itu dijadwalkan pada 14 Desember 2026. Penyelesaian merger masih bergantung pada persetujuan pemegang saham, regulator, dan syarat penutupan lainnya.
analysis: Karena laba TMTG di kuartal III sangat bergantung pada kenaikan harga bitcoin, penurunan BTC sejak akhir September ke kisaran US$74.000-an berpotensi berbalik menekan laporan kuartal IV jika harga tidak pulih. Banyaknya BTC yang dijaminkan juga berarti tidak semua kepemilikan itu bebas dipakai kapan saja. Ini interpretasi, bukan prediksi harga.

title_en: Trump Media posts US$409.7 million Q3 net income on bitcoin gains, holds about 15,649 BTC
summary_en: Trump Media & Technology Group (DJT), operator of Truth Social, reported Q3 2026 net income of US$409.7 million, mostly from non-cash gains on digital assets. Revenue was US$3.0 million. As of 30 September, the company held about 15,649 BTC, of which about 11,385 BTC were pledged to a bitcoin yield management program.
key_points_en: Q3 2026 net income reached US$409.7 million, compared with a US$54.8 million loss a year earlier, according to TMTG's official press release.

Most of the profit came from non-cash items, namely US$496.1 million in net realized and unrealized gains on digital assets, pledged digital assets and equity securities. Adjusted EBITDA was still a loss of US$12.3 million.
Revenue rose 205% to US$3.0 million from US$1.0 million, mainly from Truth API and Truth+ subscriptions.

As of 30 September, TMTG held about 15,649 BTC, with about 11,385 BTC pledged to a bitcoin yield management program, plus 7 million shares of the IBIT ETF, CFO Phillip Juhan said on the earnings call.
The company has scheduled a special shareholder meeting on 14 December 2026 to vote on its proposed merger with TAE Technologies.
why_en: TMTG is among the sizable public-company bitcoin holders. This report shows how strongly the BTC price drives the earnings of companies like this, both up and down, because most of the profit comes from revaluing assets, not from the core business.
body_en: Trump Media & Technology Group Corp. (Nasdaq, NYSE Texas: DJT), operator of the social media platform Truth Social, the streaming service Truth+ and the financial brand Truth.Fi, released its Q3 2026 results on Monday (9/11) at 16:05 New York time, or Tuesday (10/11) at 05:05 WITA.

According to the official press release, the company booked net income of US$409.7 million. Most of it came from non-cash items: US$496.1 million in net realized and unrealized gains on digital assets, pledged digital assets and equity securities. That was partly offset by a US$54.0 million loss on derivatives, US$11.9 million in accreted interest expense, US$9.4 million in stock-based compensation and US$4.0 million in investment expenses. As a result, adjusted EBITDA was still a loss of US$12.3 million.

Q3 revenue rose 205% to US$3.0 million from US$1.0 million a year earlier. The increase came mainly from subscriptions to Truth API, a data licensing product launched on 1 August 2026, and Truth+. Legal fees fell to US$2.4 million from US$20.3 million in Q3 2025. The company's total assets stood at US$2.5 billion.

On the earnings call, according to a transcript published by The Motley Fool, CFO Phillip Juhan said that as of 30 September the company held about 15,649 bitcoin, about 11,385 of which were pledged to a bitcoin yield management program, plus 7 million shares of the iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT). He also said the company acquired 4,359 BTC during Q3 using proceeds from a partial sale of its IBIT holdings. The transcript summary noted a US$378.1 million mark-to-market gain as bitcoin traded at about US$84,000 on 30 September.

According to crypto.news, the bitcoin holdings were worth about US$1.31 billion on 30 September. At a bitcoin price of US$74,450 on 10 November, they would be worth about US$1.17 billion, excluding the separate IBIT investment.

TMTG also said the SEC declared effective its Form S-4 registration statement for the proposed merger with TAE Technologies on 5 November 2026. A special shareholder meeting to vote on the merger is scheduled for 14 December 2026. Completion of the merger remains subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals and other closing conditions.
analysis_en: Because TMTG's Q3 profit depended heavily on the rise in the bitcoin price, BTC's decline since the end of September to around the US$74,000 level could weigh on the Q4 report if prices do not recover. The large amount of pledged BTC also means not all of those holdings are free to use at any time. This is interpretation, not a price prediction.

title: Cosmos serahkan protokol interoperabilitas IBC ke Linux Foundation Decentralized Trust
summary: Cosmos dan Interchain Foundation menyerahkan Inter-Blockchain Communication Protocol (IBC) ke LF Decentralized Trust, organisasi di bawah Linux Foundation. Kode IBC tetap open source dan bebas biaya, tetapi tata kelolanya kini berada di bawah piagam proyek publik yang netral.
key_points: Pengumuman disampaikan Senin (9/11/2026) lewat siaran pers resmi dan blog Cosmos. IBC kini menjadi proyek LF Decentralized Trust (LFDT).

IBC adalah protokol open source yang memungkinkan blockchain atau ledger yang berbeda saling bertukar aset dan data. Menurut siaran pers, sejak 2021 IBC telah memproses volume transaksi lebih dari US$50 miliar di lebih dari 115 jaringan.
Kode tetap open source dengan lisensi Apache 2.0, dan piagam proyek menjaga lapisan protokol bebas dari biaya atau monetisasi. Merek dagang IBC dipegang Linux Foundation atas nama proyek.
Pengelola kode (maintainer) awal adalah Cosmos Labs, Datachain, dan OpenZeppelin. Insinyur Cosmos Labs memimpin Komite Pengarah Teknis selama dua tahun pertama.
Langkah ini didukung Google Cloud serta individu dari sejumlah organisasi, termasuk Wells Fargo, Figure Markets, dan Cardano Foundation.
why_it_matters: Bank dan lembaga keuangan yang mulai menguji tokenisasi aset butuh standar penghubung antar-blockchain yang tidak dikuasai satu perusahaan. Menaruh IBC di bawah Linux Foundation, rumah proyek seperti Linux dan Kubernetes, bisa membuat protokol ini lebih mudah diterima institusi.
body: Cosmos, penyedia teknologi digital ledger open source, dan Interchain Foundation, lembaga nirlaba yang mendukung ekosistem Cosmos, mengumumkan pada Senin (9/11/2026) bahwa Inter-Blockchain Communication Protocol (IBC) diserahkan ke LF Decentralized Trust, organisasi Linux Foundation untuk pengembangan sistem dan teknologi terdesentralisasi. Siaran pers dirilis di New York pukul 09.00 waktu setempat, atau 22.00 WITA (14.00 UTC).

IBC adalah protokol interoperabilitas yang memungkinkan jaringan yang berdiri sendiri saling memverifikasi pesan secara langsung, tanpa perantara pihak ketiga. Menurut LFDT, spesifikasinya tidak terikat bahasa pemrograman, dengan implementasi dalam Go untuk jaringan Cosmos, Solidity untuk jaringan EVM termasuk Besu dan Ethereum, serta Rust. Protokol ini tidak memungut biaya dan tidak mewajibkan token tertentu.

Siaran pers menyebut IBC telah memproses volume transaksi lebih dari US$50 miliar di lebih dari 115 jaringan sejak 2021. Di blognya, Cosmos menyebut IBC dipakai di lebih dari 200 jaringan selama lebih dari lima tahun. Kedua angka berasal dari pihak Cosmos dan belum diverifikasi secara independen.

Menurut penjelasan di forum resmi Cosmos, Linux Foundation memegang merek dagang IBC atas nama proyek, kode tetap open source di bawah lisensi Apache 2.0, dan keputusan teknis berada di tangan para maintainer serta Komite Pengarah Teknis di bawah piagam teknis publik. Cosmos Labs, Datachain, dan OpenZeppelin menjadi maintainer, dan insinyur Cosmos Labs memimpin komite pada masa jabatan dua tahun pertama.

Siaran pers menyebut langkah ini didukung Google Cloud serta individu dari berbagai organisasi, antara lain Agoric, Cardano Foundation, Cosmos Labs, Datachain, Figure Markets, Injective Labs, OpenZeppelin, Turnkey, dan Wells Fargo. Cosmos menyatakan tujuannya adalah membangun standar interoperabilitas bersama yang aman dan memperkuat kolaborasi industri untuk modernisasi keuangan.
analysis: Karena IBC tidak mewajibkan token tertentu, langkah ini lebih tentang adopsi teknologi oleh institusi daripada dampak langsung ke harga token ekosistem Cosmos seperti ATOM. Yang perlu dicermati adalah apakah bank atau proyek tokenisasi benar-benar mulai memakai IBC setelah tata kelolanya netral. Ini interpretasi, bukan prediksi harga.

title_en: Cosmos hands its IBC interoperability protocol to Linux Foundation Decentralized Trust
summary_en: Cosmos and the Interchain Foundation have contributed the Inter-Blockchain Communication Protocol (IBC) to LF Decentralized Trust, an organization under the Linux Foundation. IBC's code stays open source and fee-free, but its governance now sits under a neutral public project charter.
key_points_en: The announcement was made on Monday (9/11/2026) through an official press release and a Cosmos blog post. IBC is now a project of LF Decentralized Trust (LFDT).

IBC is an open-source protocol that lets different blockchains or ledgers exchange assets and data. According to the press release, IBC has processed more than US$50 billion in transaction volume across more than 115 networks since 2021.

The code remains open source under the Apache 2.0 license, and the project charter keeps the protocol layer free of fees or monetization. The IBC trademark is held by the Linux Foundation on behalf of the project.
The initial code maintainers are Cosmos Labs, Datachain and OpenZeppelin. Cosmos Labs engineers chair the Technical Steering Committee for the first two years.
The move is supported by Google Cloud and individuals from a number of organizations, including Wells Fargo, Figure Markets and the Cardano Foundation.
why_en: Banks and financial institutions that are starting to test asset tokenization need cross-blockchain standards that no single company controls. Placing IBC under the Linux Foundation, home to projects such as Linux and Kubernetes, could make the protocol easier for institutions to accept.
body_en: Cosmos, an open-source digital ledger technology provider, and the Interchain Foundation, the non-profit that supports the Cosmos ecosystem, announced on Monday (9/11/2026) that the Inter-Blockchain Communication Protocol (IBC) is being contributed to LF Decentralized Trust, the Linux Foundation's organization for the development of decentralized systems and technologies. The press release was issued in New York at 09:00 local time, or 22:00 WITA (14:00 UTC).

IBC is an interoperability protocol that lets independent networks verify each other's messages directly, without a third-party intermediary. According to LFDT, its specifications are programming-language agnostic, with implementations in Go for Cosmos networks, Solidity for EVM networks including Besu and Ethereum, and Rust. The protocol charges no fees and does not require a specific token.

The press release says IBC has processed more than US$50 billion in transaction volume across more than 115 networks since 2021. On its blog, Cosmos says IBC has been used across more than 200 networks over more than five years. Both figures come from Cosmos and have not been independently verified.

According to an explanation on the official Cosmos forum, the Linux Foundation holds the IBC trademark on behalf of the project, the code stays open source under the Apache 2.0 license, and technical decisions rest with the maintainers and a Technical Steering Committee under a public technical charter. Cosmos Labs, Datachain and OpenZeppelin are the maintainers, and Cosmos Labs engineers chair the committee for the first two-year term.

The press release says the move is supported by Google Cloud and individuals from various organizations, including Agoric, Cardano Foundation, Cosmos Labs, Datachain, Figure Markets, Injective Labs, OpenZeppelin, Turnkey and Wells Fargo. Cosmos said the goal is to build secure, shared interoperability standards and strengthen industry collaboration for financial modernization.
analysis_en: Because IBC does not require a specific token, this move is more about institutional technology adoption than a direct impact on the price of Cosmos ecosystem tokens such as ATOM. The thing to watch is whether banks or tokenization projects actually start using IBC now that its governance is neutral. This is interpretation, not a price prediction.

title: Inflasi AS Oktober lebih panas dari perkiraan: yield obligasi 10 tahun sempat tembus 5%, emas turun 2%, Bitcoin ke terendah sejak Agustus
summary: Indeks harga konsumen (CPI) AS naik 0,4% di bulan Oktober, di atas perkiraan 0,3%. Inflasi inti naik 0,3%, juga di atas perkiraan. Pasar kini memperhitungkan penuh kenaikan suku bunga The Fed pada Desember. Yield Treasury 10 tahun sempat di atas 5%, emas turun sekitar 2%, dan Bitcoin sempat di bawah US$73.000.
key_points: Menurut Biro Statistik Tenaga Kerja AS (BLS), CPI Oktober naik 0,4% secara bulanan (perkiraan ekonom Dow Jones 0,3%). CPI inti naik 0,3% (perkiraan 0,2%). Data dirilis Selasa (10/11) pukul 08.30 waktu New York, atau 21.30 WITA (13.30 UTC).
BLS tidak merilis angka inflasi tahunan karena data Oktober 2025 tidak dikumpulkan akibat shutdown pemerintah AS tahun lalu.
Menurut CME FedWatch yang dikutip CNBC, pasar kini memperhitungkan penuh kenaikan 25 basis poin pada rapat 8-9 Desember, dengan peluang kenaikan 50 basis poin sekitar 13,6%.
Yield Treasury 10 tahun sempat di atas 5% sebelum turun ke sekitar 4,992%. Lelang surat utang 10 tahun senilai US$42 miliar dinilai lemah: dealer menyerap 10%, terbanyak sejak Mei.
Emas spot turun sekitar 2% ke kisaran US$4.053-4.055 per ons, perak turun 2,8% ke US$51,90. Menurut CoinDesk, Bitcoin sempat jatuh di bawah US$73.000, level terendah sejak Agustus.
why_it_matters: Suku bunga dan yield obligasi yang lebih tinggi membuat biaya uang naik dan aset tanpa imbal hasil seperti emas dan crypto jadi kurang menarik. Data ini memperkuat ekspektasi The Fed akan terus mengetatkan kebijakan, yang biasanya menekan aset berisiko.
body: Biro Statistik Tenaga Kerja AS (BLS) melaporkan indeks harga konsumen (CPI) naik 0,4% (disesuaikan musiman) pada Oktober 2026, lebih tinggi dari perkiraan ekonom yang disurvei Dow Jones sebesar 0,3%. Pada September, CPI naik 0,6%. CPI inti, yang tidak menghitung harga makanan dan energi yang fluktuatif, naik 0,3%, di atas perkiraan 0,2% dan sama dengan September. Data dirilis Selasa (10/11) pukul 08.30 waktu New York, atau 21.30 WITA (13.30 UTC).

BLS tidak menghitung laju inflasi tahunan kali ini. Shutdown pemerintah AS pada Oktober 2025 membuat BLS tidak mengumpulkan data survei bulan itu, sehingga tidak ada angka pembanding. Dari rinciannya, indeks energi naik 0,7%, bensin naik 1%, makanan naik 0,5%, dan biaya tempat tinggal (shelter) naik 0,3%. Menurut BLS, shelter menyumbang lebih dari 30% kenaikan bulanan CPI.

Data ini keluar beberapa jam setelah Gubernur The Fed Christopher Waller mengatakan kenaikan suku bunga 50 basis poin perlu dipertimbangkan di bulan Desember jika inflasi inti sekitar 0,3%. Menurut CME FedWatch yang dikutip CNBC, pasar kini memperhitungkan penuh kenaikan 25 basis poin pada rapat 8-9 Desember, dan peluang kenaikan 50 basis poin naik ke 13,6% dari sekitar nol sebelum data keluar. Presiden Fed Dallas Lorie Logan, setelah rilis CPI, mengatakan ia melihat perlunya dua kali lagi kenaikan seperempat poin.

Pasar obligasi langsung tertekan. Menurut CNBC, yield Treasury 10 tahun sempat diperdagangkan di atas 5% sebelum turun ke sekitar 4,992%, naik 13 basis poin. Yield 2 tahun, yang paling sensitif terhadap ekspektasi suku bunga The Fed, melonjak lebih dari 18 basis poin ke 4,736%. Lelang surat utang 10 tahun senilai US$42 miliar juga dinilai lemah; menurut Peter Boockvar dari One Point BFG Wealth Partners, dealer menyerap 10% dari lelang, porsi terbanyak sejak Mei.

Emas ikut terpukul. Kitco melaporkan emas spot terakhir di US$4.054,90 per ons, turun 2% hari itu. Anadolu Agency mencatat emas turun 2,1% ke US$4.052,90 per ons pada pukul 13.30 GMT, sementara perak turun 2,8% ke US$51,90 per ons.

Crypto juga melemah. Menurut CoinDesk, Bitcoin turun ke sekitar US$73.600 tak lama setelah rilis CPI, lalu sempat jatuh di bawah US$73.000 untuk pertama kalinya sejak Agustus, seiring Nasdaq turun sekitar 1,1%. Ether, XRP, dan Solana turun mendekati 6%.
analysis: Kombinasi inflasi yang masih tinggi, yield 10 tahun di sekitar 5%, dan ekspektasi kenaikan suku bunga lanjutan adalah kondisi yang biasanya berat untuk crypto. Data berikutnya yang perlu dipantau adalah inflasi produsen (PPI) AS pada Jumat dan indeks PCE akhir November. Ini interpretasi, bukan prediksi harga.

title_en: US October inflation runs hotter than expected: 10-year yield briefly tops 5%, gold falls 2%, Bitcoin hits lowest since August
summary_en: The US consumer price index (CPI) rose 0.4% in October, above the 0.3% forecast. Core inflation rose 0.3%, also above forecasts. Markets now fully price in a Fed rate hike in December. The 10-year Treasury yield briefly topped 5%, gold fell about 2%, and Bitcoin briefly dropped below US$73,000.
key_points_en: According to the US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), October CPI rose 0.4% month on month (Dow Jones economists' forecast: 0.3%). Core CPI rose 0.3% (forecast: 0.2%). The data was released on Tuesday (10/11) at 08:30 New York time, or 21:30 WITA (13:30 UTC).
The BLS did not publish an annual inflation figure because October 2025 data was not collected due to last year's US government shutdown.
According to CME FedWatch as cited by CNBC, markets now fully price in a 25 basis point hike at the 8-9 December meeting, with about a 13.6% chance of a 50 basis point hike.
The 10-year Treasury yield briefly traded above 5% before easing to about 4.992%. A US$42 billion 10-year note auction was seen as weak: dealers took 10%, the most since May.
Spot gold fell about 2% to around US$4,053-4,055 an ounce, and silver fell 2.8% to US$51.90. According to CoinDesk, Bitcoin briefly fell below US$73,000, its lowest level since August.
why_en: Higher interest rates and bond yields raise the cost of money and make non-yielding assets such as gold and crypto less attractive. This data strengthens expectations that the Fed will keep tightening policy, which usually weighs on risk assets.
body_en: The US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reported that the consumer price index (CPI) rose a seasonally adjusted 0.4% in October 2026, higher than the 0.3% expected by economists surveyed by Dow Jones. In September, CPI rose 0.6%. Core CPI, which excludes volatile food and energy prices, rose 0.3%, above the 0.2% forecast and the same as in September. The data was released on Tuesday (10/11) at 08:30 New York time, or 21:30 WITA (13:30 UTC).

The BLS did not calculate an annual inflation rate this time. The US government shutdown in October 2025 meant the BLS did not collect survey data that month, so there is no comparable figure. In the details, the energy index rose 0.7%, gasoline rose 1%, food rose 0.5% and shelter costs rose 0.3%. According to the BLS, shelter accounted for more than 30% of the monthly CPI increase.

The data came a few hours after Fed Governor Christopher Waller said a 50 basis point rate hike should be considered in December if core inflation was around 0.3%. According to CME FedWatch as cited by CNBC, markets now fully price in a 25 basis point hike at the 8-9 December meeting, and the odds of a 50 basis point hike rose to 13.6% from around zero before the data. Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan, after the CPI release, said she sees a need for two more quarter-point increases.

The bond market came under immediate pressure. According to CNBC, the 10-year Treasury yield briefly traded above 5% before easing to about 4.992%, up 13 basis points. The 2-year yield, which is most sensitive to Fed rate expectations, jumped more than 18 basis points to 4.736%. A US$42 billion 10-year note auction was also seen as weak; according to Peter Boockvar of One Point BFG Wealth Partners, dealers took 10% of the auction, the most since May.

Gold was hit too. Kitco reported spot gold last at US$4,054.90 an ounce, down 2% on the day. Anadolu Agency noted gold fell 2.1% to US$4,052.90 an ounce as of 13:30 GMT, while silver fell 2.8% to US$51.90 an ounce.

Crypto also weakened. According to CoinDesk, Bitcoin fell to around US$73,600 shortly after the CPI release, then briefly dropped below US$73,000 for the first time since August, as the Nasdaq fell about 1.1%. Ether, XRP and Solana fell closer to 6%.
analysis_en: The combination of still-high inflation, a 10-year yield around 5% and expectations of further rate hikes is a backdrop that is usually tough for crypto. The next data to watch are US producer price inflation (PPI) on Friday and the PCE index at the end of November. This is interpretation, not a price prediction.

title: IPO Anthropic, pembuat Claude, bidik dana hingga US$64,4 miliar dengan valuasi sampai US$1,4 triliun
summary: Anthropic dan sebagian pemegang sahamnya berencana menjual 825 juta saham di rentang harga US$70-78 per saham, menurut prospektus terbaru yang diajukan ke SEC. Saham dijadwalkan mulai diperdagangkan di Nasdaq pada 19 November dengan kode ANT, menurut Reuters.
key_points: Menurut Reuters, prospektus terbaru yang diajukan ke SEC pada Selasa (10/11) menunjukkan IPO bisa mengumpulkan hingga US$64,4 miliar dari penjualan 825 juta saham di harga US$70-78.
Di batas atas harga, valuasi Anthropic sekitar US$1,4 triliun secara fully diluted, atau sekitar US$1 triliun tanpa menghitung opsi saham dan saham terbatas.
Anthropic juga akan mengumpulkan US$26 miliar lewat penempatan privat dengan investor cornerstone, termasuk Google, Nvidia, dan AMD. Total dana bisa mencapai US$90,4 miliar.
Saham dijadwalkan mulai diperdagangkan di Nasdaq pada 19 November dengan kode "ANT". Goldman Sachs dan Morgan Stanley memimpin penjaminan emisi.
Sehari sebelumnya, detail awal yang menunjukkan dana hingga US$69,3 miliar sempat beredar ke bank lalu ditarik; Anthropic menyebut informasi itu tidak akurat.
why_it_matters: Ini salah satu IPO terbesar tahun ini dan akan menjadi tolok ukur pertama di pasar publik untuk valuasi perusahaan AI frontier. Hasilnya bisa memengaruhi sentimen sektor AI secara luas, termasuk saham teknologi dan token crypto bertema AI.
body: Anthropic, pengembang chatbot Claude, mengajukan prospektus terbaru ke Komisi Sekuritas dan Bursa AS (SEC) pada Selasa (10/11/2026). Menurut Reuters, perusahaan dan sebagian pemegang saham lamanya menargetkan dana hingga US$64,4 miliar dengan menjual 825 juta saham di rentang harga indikatif US$70-78 per saham. Anthropic juga memulai roadshow, yaitu rangkaian presentasi ke calon investor.

Di batas atas rentang harga, Anthropic akan bernilai sekitar US$1,4 triliun secara fully diluted, yang memasukkan efek seperti opsi saham dan saham terbatas. Tanpa efek tersebut, nilai pasarnya sekitar US$1 triliun. Reuters mencatat angka ini sedikit di bawah ekspektasi sebagian investor. Pada putaran pendanaan privat terakhir, Anthropic dinilai US$965 miliar.

Selain IPO, Anthropic akan mengumpulkan US$26 miliar lewat penempatan privat terpisah dengan investor cornerstone, antara lain Google (Alphabet), Nvidia, AMD, Broadcom, Micron, Microsoft, dan TSMC. Totalnya, penawaran saham ini bisa mengumpulkan hingga US$90,4 miliar. Menurut Bloomberg yang dikutip CoinDesk, angkanya bisa naik ke sekitar US$100 miliar jika opsi kelebihan penjatahan (over-allotment) digunakan.

Saham dijadwalkan mulai diperdagangkan di Nasdaq pada 19 November dengan kode "ANT". Goldman Sachs dan Morgan Stanley menjadi penjamin emisi utama. Reuters juga melaporkan, pada Senin malam detail IPO sempat diedarkan ke bank investasi lalu ditarik. Detail awal itu menunjukkan dana hingga US$69,3 miliar, dan Anthropic menyebut informasi tersebut tidak akurat.

Menurut dokumen IPO yang dikutip Reuters, pendapatan run-rate Anthropic sekitar US$81 miliar per 31 Oktober, naik US$10 miliar dari 30 September. Perusahaan juga memiliki komitmen komputasi hampir US$900 miliar dengan mitra seperti Amazon dan Google. Prospektus itu memuat sejumlah risiko, termasuk pesaing yang bisa mengembangkan model lebih cepat dan kemajuan AI yang bisa melampaui kemampuan perusahaan menerapkan pengamanan yang memadai.
analysis: IPO ini datang saat saham teknologi sedang tertekan oleh suku bunga tinggi dan keraguan soal imbal hasil belanja AI. Jika permintaan kuat, itu bisa jadi sinyal positif untuk sentimen sektor AI; jika lemah, tekanan ke saham dan token bertema AI bisa bertambah. Ini interpretasi, bukan prediksi harga.

title_en: Anthropic, maker of Claude, targets up to US$64.4 billion in IPO at a valuation of up to US$1.4 trillion
summary_en: Anthropic and some of its shareholders plan to sell 825 million shares in a price range of US$70-78 per share, according to an updated prospectus filed with the SEC. The shares are scheduled to start trading on the Nasdaq on 19 November under the symbol ANT, according to Reuters.
key_points_en: According to Reuters, an updated prospectus filed with the SEC on Tuesday (10/11) shows the IPO could raise up to US$64.4 billion from the sale of 825 million shares at US$70-78.
At the top of the range, Anthropic's valuation is about US$1.4 trillion on a fully diluted basis, or about US$1 trillion excluding stock options and restricted stock.
Anthropic will also raise US$26 billion through a private placement with cornerstone investors, including Google, Nvidia and AMD. Total proceeds could reach US$90.4 billion.
The shares are scheduled to start trading on the Nasdaq on 19 November under the symbol "ANT". Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley are leading the underwriting.
A day earlier, preliminary details pointing to proceeds of up to US$69.3 billion briefly circulated to banks and were then retracted; Anthropic said that information was inaccurate.
why_en: This is one of the year's biggest IPOs and will be the first public-market benchmark for the valuation of frontier AI companies. The outcome could affect sentiment across the AI sector, including tech stocks and AI-themed crypto tokens.
body_en: Anthropic, developer of the Claude chatbot, filed an updated prospectus with the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on Tuesday (10/11/2026). According to Reuters, the company and some of its existing shareholders are aiming to raise up to US$64.4 billion by selling 825 million shares in an indicative price range of US$70-78 per share. Anthropic is also kicking off its roadshow, a series of presentations to prospective investors.

At the top of the price range, Anthropic would be valued at about US$1.4 trillion on a fully diluted basis, which includes securities such as stock options and restricted stock. Excluding those securities, its market value would be about US$1 trillion. Reuters noted this is slightly short of some investors' expectations. In its last private funding round, Anthropic was valued at US$965 billion.

In addition to the IPO, Anthropic will raise US$26 billion through a separate private placement with cornerstone investors including Google (Alphabet), Nvidia, AMD, Broadcom, Micron, Microsoft and TSMC. In total, the share offering could raise up to US$90.4 billion. According to Bloomberg as cited by CoinDesk, that could rise to about US$100 billion if an over-allotment option is exercised.

The shares are scheduled to start trading on the Nasdaq on 19 November under the symbol "ANT". Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley are the lead underwriters. Reuters also reported that late on Monday, IPO details were briefly circulated to investment banks and then retracted. Those preliminary details pointed to proceeds of up to US$69.3 billion, and Anthropic said the information was inaccurate.

According to the IPO filing as cited by Reuters, Anthropic's run-rate revenue was about US$81 billion as of 31 October, up US$10 billion from 30 September. The company also has nearly US$900 billion in computing commitments with partners such as Amazon and Google. The prospectus lists a range of risks, including competitors developing models faster and advances in AI outpacing the company's ability to put adequate safeguards in place.
analysis_en: This IPO comes as tech stocks are under pressure from high interest rates and doubts about the returns on AI spending. If demand is strong, it could be a positive signal for AI sector sentiment; if it is weak, pressure on AI-themed stocks and tokens could increase. This is interpretation, not a price prediction.

title: BEI ubah metodologi saham HSC: daftar bertambah 300 jadi 383 saham, akan dikeluarkan dari perhitungan IHSG
summary: Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) mengubah cara menyaring saham dengan kepemilikan sangat terkonsentrasi (Hidden Shareholder Concentration/HSC). Kini seluruh saham tercatat disaring, dan saham yang 92,5% atau lebih dikuasai 10 pemegang saham atau kurang masuk daftar HSC. Total saham HSC menjadi 383.
key_points: Keputusan Komite HSC diumumkan Direktur Utama BEI Jeffrey Hendrik di Jakarta, Selasa (10/11/2026).
Ambang batas kapitalisasi pasar di atas Rp5 triliun tidak lagi dipakai; penyaringan kini mencakup seluruh saham tercatat. Price impact ratio juga tidak lagi diperhitungkan.
Kriteria baru: 10 pemegang saham atau kurang yang bersama-sama menguasai 92,5% saham atau lebih.
Ada tambahan 300 saham, sehingga total menjadi 383 saham HSC (sebelumnya 83), atau tambahan sekitar 6,16% dari kapitalisasi pasar IHSG. Saham HSC dikeluarkan dari perhitungan IHSG.
Untuk keluar dari daftar, emiten harus menunjukkan distribusi saham yang lebih baik ke publik lewat transaksi pasar reguler. Daftar lengkap akan diumumkan dalam waktu dekat.
why_it_matters: Saham dengan porsi publik (free float) sangat kecil harganya lebih mudah digerakkan segelintir pihak. Dengan dikeluarkannya saham-saham ini dari IHSG, pergerakan indeks diharapkan lebih mencerminkan saham yang benar-benar likuid.
body: Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) mengumumkan sejumlah keputusan Komite Hidden Shareholder Concentration (HSC) pada Selasa (10/11/2026). Menurut CNBC Indonesia, keputusan itu mencakup pembukaan metodologi kepada publik, perubahan kriteria penyaringan saham, dan penambahan daftar saham HSC secara signifikan.

Direktur Utama BEI Jeffrey Hendrik mengatakan ada penambahan 300 saham yang masuk kriteria HSC, sehingga totalnya menjadi 383 saham, atau tambahan sekitar 6,16% dari kapitalisasi pasar IHSG. "Kami akan segera umumkan daftar saham HSC yang terbaru yang akan terdiri dari 383 saham atau ada penambahan 300 saham baru yang akan masuk dalam saham HSC," ujarnya di gedung BEI, Jakarta, seperti dikutip CNBC Indonesia.

Penambahan ini terjadi karena metodologi baru. Ambang batas kapitalisasi saham di atas Rp5 triliun tidak lagi digunakan, sehingga penyaringan dilakukan terhadap seluruh saham tercatat. Metodologi baru juga tidak lagi memperhitungkan price impact ratio, jadi penetapan tidak perlu menunggu pergerakan harga saham. Komite memutuskan saham dengan 10 pemegang saham atau kurang yang bersama-sama menguasai 92,5% saham atau lebih masuk daftar HSC.

Saham-saham HSC akan dikeluarkan dari perhitungan Indeks Harga Saham Gabungan (IHSG), menurut CNN Indonesia dan ANTARA. Untuk keluar dari daftar, perusahaan tercatat harus menyampaikan ke bursa bahwa sudah ada distribusi saham yang lebih baik ke publik, dan distribusi itu harus dilakukan lewat transaksi pasar reguler. Komite akan meninjau daftar secara berkala.

Jeffrey menambahkan, pengumuman daftar akan dilakukan dalam waktu dekat agar tim operasional dan penyedia data bisa menyesuaikan daftar saham yang dikeluarkan dari perhitungan IHSG. Ia juga menyatakan bursa akan memakai seluruh ketentuan yang berlaku untuk memberi sanksi jika menemukan laporan yang tidak akurat.
analysis: Bagi investor ritel, daftar HSC bisa jadi alat bantu untuk mengenali saham yang porsi publiknya tipis dan rawan pergerakan harga ekstrem. Cek struktur kepemilikan sebelum membeli saham yang sedang ramai dibicarakan. Ini interpretasi, bukan rekomendasi saham.

title_en: IDX changes its HSC stock methodology: list grows by 300 to 383 stocks, to be removed from the JCI calculation
summary_en: The Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX/BEI) has changed how it screens stocks with highly concentrated ownership (Hidden Shareholder Concentration, HSC). All listed stocks are now screened, and stocks of which 92.5% or more is held by 10 or fewer shareholders go on the HSC list. The total number of HSC stocks is now 383.
key_points_en: The HSC Committee's decisions were announced by IDX President Director Jeffrey Hendrik in Jakarta on Tuesday (10/11/2026).
The threshold of market capitalization above Rp5 trillion is no longer used; screening now covers all listed stocks. The price impact ratio is also no longer taken into account.
New criterion: 10 or fewer shareholders who together control 92.5% or more of the shares.
300 stocks were added, bringing the total to 383 HSC stocks (previously 83), an addition of about 6.16% of JCI market capitalization. HSC stocks are removed from the JCI (IHSG) calculation.
To leave the list, issuers must show better distribution of shares to the public through regular market transactions. The full list will be announced soon.
why_en: Stocks with a very small public portion (free float) are easier for a handful of parties to move. By removing these stocks from the JCI, index movements are expected to better reflect genuinely liquid stocks.
body_en: The Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX/BEI) announced a number of decisions by its Hidden Shareholder Concentration (HSC) Committee on Tuesday (10/11/2026). According to CNBC Indonesia, the decisions include opening the methodology to the public, changing the stock screening criteria and significantly expanding the HSC list.

IDX President Director Jeffrey Hendrik said 300 additional stocks meet the HSC criteria, bringing the total to 383 stocks, an addition of about 6.16% of JCI market capitalization. "We will soon announce the latest HSC list, which will consist of 383 stocks, or an addition of 300 new stocks that will enter the HSC list," he said at the IDX building in Jakarta, as quoted by CNBC Indonesia.

The increase is due to the new methodology. The threshold of market capitalization above Rp5 trillion is no longer used, so screening covers all listed stocks. The new methodology also no longer takes the price impact ratio into account, so designation does not have to wait for share price movements. The committee decided that stocks where 10 or fewer shareholders together control 92.5% or more of the shares go on the HSC list.

HSC stocks will be removed from the calculation of the Jakarta Composite Index (JCI/IHSG), according to CNN Indonesia and ANTARA. To leave the list, a listed company must notify the exchange that there has been better distribution of shares to the public, and that distribution must be carried out through regular market transactions. The committee will review the list regularly.

Jeffrey added that the list will be announced soon so that operations teams and data vendors can adjust the list of stocks removed from the JCI calculation. He also said the exchange will use all applicable regulations to impose sanctions if it finds inaccurate reports.
analysis_en: For retail investors, the HSC list can be a tool for spotting stocks with a thin public float that are prone to extreme price moves. Check the ownership structure before buying a stock that everyone is talking about. This is interpretation, not a stock recommendation.

title: Kazakhstan sudah tanam US$190 juta dari cadangan crypto negara senilai US$700 juta ke hedge fund dan ETF
summary: Wakil Gubernur Bank Nasional Kazakhstan Binur Zhalenov mengatakan sekitar US$190 juta dari cadangan crypto nasional senilai US$700 juta sudah diinvestasikan ke hedge fund dan ETF aset digital per akhir Oktober 2026. Ia juga menyebut Kazakhstan berinvestasi di Anthropic sejak 2025.
key_points: Angka US$190 juta disampaikan Zhalenov dalam wawancara dengan kantor berita Kazinform, yang kemudian diunggah Bank Nasional Kazakhstan.
Cadangan crypto dibentuk Desember 2025 dengan dua kontribusi masing-masing US$350 juta: dari aset emas dan devisa bank sentral, dan dari National Fund Kazakhstan.

Menurut Bloomberg (dirangkum Galaxy Research dan crypto.news), sekitar US$100 juta masuk ke fund berfokus crypto, termasuk Ege DeFi dan Brevan Howard Digital, dan sekitar US$90 juta ke aset crypto dan ETF berbasis bitcoin.
Portofolio dikelola National Investment Corporation, anak usaha Bank Nasional.
Zhalenov juga menyebut Kazakhstan berinvestasi di Anthropic pada 2025. Menurut Qazinform (Mei 2026), nilainya US$25 juta di putaran Series F.
why_it_matters: Kazakhstan termasuk sedikit negara yang memakai dana cadangan untuk masuk ke crypto, dan memilih jalur produk yang teregulasi seperti fund dan ETF, bukan membeli koin secara langsung. Ini contoh bagaimana lembaga negara mulai mengelola eksposur crypto.
body: Bank Nasional Kazakhstan mulai memutar cadangan crypto negaranya. Dalam wawancara dengan Kazinform yang dipublikasikan 9 November 2026, Wakil Gubernur Binur Zhalenov mengatakan sekitar US$190 juta dari cadangan crypto nasional senilai US$700 juta sudah diinvestasikan ke hedge fund dan exchange-traded fund (ETF) aset digital per akhir Oktober.

Menurut crypto.news yang mengutip wawancara itu, cadangan tersebut dibentuk pada Desember 2025 dengan kontribusi yang sama besar dari aset emas dan devisa bank sentral serta National Fund Kazakhstan, masing-masing US$350 juta. Portofolio dikelola National Investment Corporation, anak usaha Bank Nasional. Berdasarkan angka yang diungkap, sekitar 27% dana sudah diinvestasikan dan sekitar US$510 juta belum.

Rinciannya diungkap lebih dulu dalam sebuah konferensi di Almaty. Galaxy Research, merangkum laporan Bloomberg, menyebut sekitar US$100 juta masuk ke fund yang berfokus pada crypto, termasuk Ege DeFi dan Brevan Howard Digital. crypto.news mencatat sekitar US$90 juta lainnya masuk ke aset crypto dan ETF berbasis bitcoin; Bloomberg mengelompokkan keduanya tanpa merinci berapa porsi masing-masing.

Zhalenov juga menyebut Kazakhstan berinvestasi di Anthropic, pengembang AI Claude, pada 2025, dan valuasi perusahaan itu sudah naik berkali-kali lipat sejak itu. Menurut Qazinform pada Mei 2026, National Investment Corporation ikut putaran pendanaan Series F Anthropic di akhir 2025 dengan nilai US$25 juta, saat Anthropic dinilai sekitar US$183 miliar.

Menurut laporan yang sama, cadangan ini nantinya juga akan ditambah dengan aset digital yang disita berdasarkan putusan pengadilan dan dari penambangan strategis, namun perubahan hukum untuk keduanya masih disiapkan.
analysis: Langkah ini menunjukkan pola yang juga dicatat Galaxy Research: lembaga negara dan pengelola dana jangka panjang masuk ke crypto lewat jalur teregulasi. Nilainya masih kecil dibanding pasar crypto, jadi dampak langsung ke harga kemungkinan terbatas. Ini interpretasi, bukan prediksi harga.

title_en: Kazakhstan has put US$190 million of its US$700 million state crypto reserve into hedge funds and ETFs
summary_en: National Bank of Kazakhstan Deputy Governor Binur Zhalenov said about US$190 million of the US$700 million national crypto reserve had been invested in digital-asset hedge funds and ETFs by the end of October 2026. He also said Kazakhstan has been invested in Anthropic since 2025.
key_points_en: The US$190 million figure was given by Zhalenov in an interview with the Kazinform news agency, which was then posted by the National Bank of Kazakhstan.
The crypto reserve was set up in December 2025 with two contributions of US$350 million each: from the central bank's gold and foreign exchange assets, and from Kazakhstan's National Fund.

According to Bloomberg (summarized by Galaxy Research and crypto.news), about US$100 million went into crypto-focused funds, including Ege DeFi and Brevan Howard Digital, and about US$90 million into crypto assets and bitcoin-focused ETFs.
The portfolio is managed by the National Investment Corporation, a subsidiary of the National Bank.
Zhalenov also said Kazakhstan invested in Anthropic in 2025. According to Qazinform (May 2026), the amount was US$25 million in the Series F round.
why_en: Kazakhstan is one of only a few countries using reserve funds to enter crypto, and it has chosen regulated products such as funds and ETFs rather than buying coins directly. It is an example of how state institutions are starting to manage crypto exposure.
body_en: The National Bank of Kazakhstan has started putting its state crypto reserve to work. In an interview with Kazinform published on 9 November 2026, Deputy Governor Binur Zhalenov said about US$190 million of the US$700 million national crypto reserve had been invested in digital-asset hedge funds and exchange-traded funds (ETFs) by the end of October.

According to crypto.news, citing the interview, the reserve was set up in December 2025 with equal contributions from the central bank's gold and foreign exchange assets and Kazakhstan's National Fund, US$350 million each. The portfolio is managed by the National Investment Corporation, a subsidiary of the National Bank. Based on the disclosed figures, about 27% of the funds have been invested and about US$510 million have not.

Details were disclosed earlier at a conference in Almaty. Galaxy Research, summarizing a Bloomberg report, said about US$100 million went into crypto-focused funds, including Ege DeFi and Brevan Howard Digital. crypto.news noted that another roughly US$90 million went into crypto assets and bitcoin-focused ETFs; Bloomberg grouped the two without specifying how much went to each.

Zhalenov also said Kazakhstan invested in Anthropic, the developer of the Claude AI, in 2025, and that the company's valuation has since risen several times over. According to Qazinform in May 2026, the National Investment Corporation joined Anthropic's Series F funding round in late 2025 with US$25 million, when Anthropic was valued at about US$183 billion.

According to the same reports, the reserve will later also be topped up with digital assets confiscated by court order and from strategic mining, but the legal changes for both are still being prepared.
analysis_en: This move reflects a pattern also noted by Galaxy Research: state institutions and long-term fund managers entering crypto through regulated channels. The amount is still small relative to the crypto market, so the direct impact on prices is likely limited. This is interpretation, not a price prediction.

title: Securitize, platform tokenisasi aset, akuisisi River One dan umumkan buyback US$50 juta; saham melonjak 41%
summary: Securitize (NYSE: SECZ) melaporkan pendapatan kuartal III 2026 sebesar US$18,6 juta, naik 13%, dengan rugi bersih US$66,3 juta yang sebagian besar berasal dari biaya non-tunai terkait pencatatan saham. Perusahaan juga akan mengakuisisi River One dan mengumumkan program pembelian kembali saham US$50 juta.
key_points: Pendapatan kuartal III naik 13% secara tahunan menjadi US$18,6 juta, tertinggi kedua dalam sejarah perusahaan, menurut siaran pers resmi 9 November 2026.
Rugi bersih US$66,3 juta; sekitar US$60 juta di antaranya biaya yang sebagian besar non-tunai terkait merger dan pencatatan saham. EBITDA yang disesuaikan rugi US$2,0 juta.
Aset tertokenisasi di platform rata-rata US$5,0 miliar di kuartal III (naik 39%), dan US$4,8 miliar per 30 September.

Securitize akan mengakuisisi River One, platform pembiayaan berbasis aset (asset-backed financing) yang menghubungkan modal stablecoin dengan pasar pinjaman tradisional. Nilai transaksi tidak diungkap.
Menurut CoinDesk, saham SECZ naik 41% ke US$9,86 pada Selasa setelah Citigroup menaikkan rekomendasi menjadi buy.
why_it_matters: Tokenisasi, yaitu menaruh aset seperti dana investasi dan saham di blockchain, jadi salah satu tema besar crypto institusional. Kinerja Securitize, salah satu perusahaan tokenisasi yang sudah melantai di bursa, sering dipakai sebagai gambaran perkembangan sektor ini.
body: Securitize Corp. (NYSE: SECZ), platform tokenisasi aset yang berbasis di Miami, merilis laporan keuangan kuartal III 2026 pada Senin (9/11/2026). Menurut siaran pers resmi, pendapatan total naik 13% dibanding periode yang sama tahun lalu menjadi US$18,6 juta, angka kuartalan tertinggi kedua dalam sejarah perusahaan.

Perusahaan membukukan rugi bersih US$66,3 juta, atau US$0,41 per saham. Sekitar US$60 juta dari rugi itu, sekitar 90%, adalah biaya yang sebagian besar non-tunai dan beban akuntansi, terutama terkait merger dan pencatatan saham di bursa. EBITDA yang disesuaikan rugi US$2,0 juta, dibanding positif US$3,6 juta setahun sebelumnya. Securitize menyebut punya kas sekitar US$300 juta tanpa utang di akhir kuartal.

Dari sisi bisnis, rata-rata aset tertokenisasi di platform mencapai rekor US$5,0 miliar pada kuartal III, naik 39%, dengan total US$4,8 miliar per 30 September. Volume transaksi naik 20% menjadi US$4,3 miliar. Namun aset yang diadministrasikan oleh unit Securitize Fund Services turun 29% menjadi US$25,2 miliar.

Securitize juga mengumumkan perjanjian definitif untuk mengakuisisi River One (River Credit Labs Inc.), platform pembiayaan berbasis aset untuk institusi yang mengembangkan teknologi untuk menghubungkan modal stablecoin dengan pasar pinjaman tradisional. River One diinkubasi Framework Ventures dan didukung Maple Finance. Nilai transaksi tidak diungkap, dan penyelesaian diperkirakan pada kuartal IV 2026. Dewan direksi juga menyetujui program pembelian kembali saham hingga US$50 juta yang berlaku sampai 31 Desember 2027.

Menurut CNBC, saham Securitize naik sekitar 10% di perdagangan setelah jam bursa pada Senin. Pada Selasa, menurut CoinDesk, saham SECZ melonjak 41% ke US$9,86 setelah Citigroup menaikkan rekomendasinya dari neutral menjadi buy dengan target harga US$14, meski masih turun 17% dalam sebulan terakhir.
analysis: Lonjakan saham ini terjadi setelah penurunan besar sejak akhir September, jadi volatilitasnya tinggi. Langkah ke pembiayaan berbasis aset dengan modal stablecoin menunjukkan perusahaan tokenisasi mencari sumber pendapatan baru di luar biaya penerbitan token. Ini interpretasi, bukan rekomendasi saham.

title_en: Tokenization platform Securitize to acquire River One, announces US$50 million buyback; shares jump 41%
summary_en: Securitize (NYSE: SECZ) reported Q3 2026 revenue of US$18.6 million, up 13%, with a net loss of US$66.3 million that came mostly from non-cash costs related to its listing. The company will also acquire River One and announced a US$50 million share buyback program.
key_points_en: Q3 revenue rose 13% year on year to US$18.6 million, the second highest in the company's history, according to the official press release of 9 November 2026.
Net loss was US$66.3 million; about US$60 million of it was largely non-cash costs related to its business combination and listing. Adjusted EBITDA was a loss of US$2.0 million.
Tokenized assets on the platform averaged US$5.0 billion in Q3 (up 39%), and stood at US$4.8 billion as of 30 September.
Securitize will acquire River One, an asset-backed financing platform that connects stablecoin capital with traditional lending markets. Terms were not disclosed.
According to CoinDesk, SECZ shares rose 41% to US$9.86 on Tuesday after Citigroup upgraded them to buy.
why_en: Tokenization, putting assets such as investment funds and stocks on a blockchain, has become one of the big themes of institutional crypto. The performance of Securitize, one of the listed tokenization companies, is often used as a gauge of how the sector is developing.
body_en: Securitize Corp. (NYSE: SECZ), a Miami-based asset tokenization platform, released its Q3 2026 results on Monday (9/11/2026). According to the official press release, total revenue rose 13% from the same period a year earlier to US$18.6 million, the second-highest quarterly figure in the company's history.

The company booked a net loss of US$66.3 million, or US$0.41 per share. About US$60 million of that loss, around 90%, consisted of largely non-cash expenses and accounting charges, mainly related to its business combination and public listing. Adjusted EBITDA was a loss of US$2.0 million, compared with a positive US$3.6 million a year earlier. Securitize said it had about US$300 million in cash and no debt at the end of the quarter.

On the business side, average tokenized assets on the platform reached a record US$5.0 billion in Q3, up 39%, with a total of US$4.8 billion as of 30 September. Transaction volume rose 20% to US$4.3 billion. However, assets under administration at its Securitize Fund Services unit fell 29% to US$25.2 billion.

Securitize also announced a definitive agreement to acquire River One (River Credit Labs Inc.), an institutional asset-backed financing platform developing technology to connect stablecoin capital with traditional lending markets. River One was incubated by Framework Ventures and backed by Maple Finance. Terms were not disclosed, and the deal is expected to close in Q4 2026. The board also authorized a share repurchase program of up to US$50 million running until 31 December 2027.

According to CNBC, Securitize shares rose about 10% in after-hours trading on Monday. On Tuesday, according to CoinDesk, SECZ shares jumped 41% to US$9.86 after Citigroup upgraded the stock from neutral to buy with a US$14 price target, although it was still down 17% over the past month.
analysis_en: This jump came after a steep decline since late September, so volatility is high. The move into asset-backed financing with stablecoin capital shows tokenization companies looking for new revenue sources beyond token issuance fees. This is interpretation, not a stock recommendation.
